conversation.text: You tapped "Little support". What is happening?

I'm in week 3 as an Order-to-Cash billing analyst. My team lead is on calls with Europe all day, so whenever I get stuck on a billing dispute, my Teams messages don't get answered until the next morning. Yesterday, a customer credit note ended up waiting two days. It would really help if we could set up a fixed 15-minute daily slot together, or if there were a backup person I could ask when she's tied up.

Here is what I will tell HR: The new hire reports delayed responses to questions when facing billing disputes due to the supervisor's schedule.
